info.title: AgentFlow API
info.description:
REST API for AgentFlow — an open-source workflow automation platform.

**Authentication** — send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with a JWT access token (POST /api/auth/login) or a personal API key (`af_…`, POST /api/api-keys).

**Rate limiting** — 200 requests/minute per user or IP by default; stricter limits apply to auth, AI and checkout endpoints.

**Pagination** — list endpoints accept `page` and `limit` (max 100) and return the applied values in the `X-Page` and `X-Limit` response headers.

get.summary: Get organization usage statistics and quota limits

200.description: Organization usage and quota metrics breakdown

get.summary: Telemetry summary metrics in JSON format

post.summary: Create an account (with a default organization)
post.description: Creates the user and a personal organization where they are OWNER. The response is intentionally identical whether or not the email already exists (10 requests/hour rate limit).
Rate limited to 10 requests per 15 minutes.

200.description: Tokens and the user's first organization

post.description: Validates and rotates the refresh token (single-use) and returns a fresh access token. Rate limited to 30 requests per 15 minutes.

requestBody.description: Optional — revokes the given token when present

post.description: Always returns 200 to avoid account enumeration (5 requests/hour rate limit). Email delivery is stubbed in the current MVP.

get.description: Redirects (302) to the provider's consent screen. Requires the matching `*_CLIENT_ID`/`*_CLIENT_SECRET` env vars; returns 501 OAUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED otherwise.

302.description: Redirect to the provider authorization URL

get.description: Exchanges the authorization code, then returns an HTML page that auto-submits the tokens to `{NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/auth/callback` via POST. On failure, redirects to `/register?error=…`.

200.description: HTML auto-submit form carrying the token pair

302.description: Redirect to the frontend with an error

get.summary: List workflows of the active organization

post.description: Enforces the workflow limit of the organization's plan (403 WORKFLOW_LIMIT_REACHED).

400.description: Validation failed or user has no organization (NO_ORG)

get.summary: Get a workflow with canvas and latest version

put.description: When `nodes` or `edges` are present, both are treated as the full canvas: existing nodes/edges are replaced and a new immutable WorkflowVersion snapshot is recorded.

patch.summary: Partially update workflow metadata and/or canvas

put.description: Validates node ids for uniqueness and edge endpoints for existence, persists nodes/edges atomically, and snapshots a new version.

post.description: Enqueues an execution (BullMQ when Redis is available, inline otherwise) and records usage against the organization's monthly quota.

post.summary: Trigger a workflow execution via API
post.description: Quota-checked. Ideal for scheduled/CI invocations using an API key.

post.summary: Cancel a pending or running execution

get.summary: List node-level logs of an execution

post.description: Values are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM (CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY).

get.description: Restricted to organization OWNER and ADMIN members.

403.description: Only owners and admins can reveal credentials

get.summary: List pending approvals across your organizations

404.description: Approval not found or already decided
Approval not found or already decided

post.summary: Generate a workflow from a natural-language prompt
post.description: Sends the prompt to the NVIDIA NIM provider (meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct), parses and validates the returned workflow. Rate limited to 20 requests/minute. Requires NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY.

502.description: Provider returned an invalid workflow (AI_INVALID_OUTPUT / AI_PROVIDER_ERROR)

get.summary: Usage records for the current user

post.description: Requires STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (503 STRIPE_NOT_CONFIGURED otherwise). The priceId must match one of the configured STRIPE_PRICE_ID_* values when any are set. Rate limited to 10/hour.

priceId.description: Stripe price ID of the plan to subscribe to

400.description: priceId required (PRICE_REQUIRED), unknown price (INVALID_PRICE), or no organization (NO_ORG)

post.description: Verifies the `stripe-signature` header against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and keeps the local Subscription table in sync (checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.updated/deleted).

get.summary: List organizations the user belongs to

404.description: Not a member or does not exist

post.summary: Add a registered user to the organization
post.description: Invites target existing accounts only — the invitee must register first. Only OWNER can grant the ADMIN role; ADMIN inviters are capped at MEMBER.

409.description: Already a member (ALREADY_MEMBER) or pending invite

200.description: API keys, newest first. Values are stored hashed and never returned.

post.description: The plaintext `af_…` key is returned exactly once; only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

get.description: Signing secrets are never included in list responses.

post.description: Generates a random signing secret when none is supplied. The secret is returned exactly once, in this response. Paths must be unique.

201.description: Created webhook — store the secret now

post.description: No authentication token — access is granted by knowing the path **and** a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body (`X-Webhook-Signature` header, computed with the webhook secret). The request method must match the webhook's configured method. Enforces the organization's monthly execution quota. Rate limited to 60 requests/minute.

schema.description: Webhook path configured at creation time

requestBody.description: Arbitrary JSON payload delivered to the workflow as execution input

405.description: Method does not match the webhook configuration

post.description: Execute MCP protocol requests (initialize, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read, prompts/list, prompts/get).

requestBody.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request or batch array of requests

get.description: Opens a Server-Sent Events stream for bidirectional MCP communication.

get.summary: Get MCP server health and exposed tool metrics

ApiError.description: Error envelope used by every non-2xx response

message.example: If registration can be completed, you can sign in with your credentials.

data.description: Value is never returned in listings

url.description: Stripe Checkout URL to redirect the user to

key.description: Plaintext key — returned exactly once. Send as a Bearer token.

bearerAuth.description: AgentFlow access token (from POST /api/auth/login) or a personal API key (`af_…`, from POST /api/api-keys). Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

webhookSignature.name: X-Webhook-Signature
webhookSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the raw request body, computed with the webhook secret (optional `sha256=` prefix). Required on every /api/webhooks/trigger/{path} call.
